one_liner: Embeddable ecommerce platform with REST API for store management.

evidence.claim: Ecwid REST API uses OAuth 2.0 for authorization
evidence.quote: We use OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single-store customizations, JSON-formatted data, and a clear structure.

evidence.claim: All API requests require an access token
evidence.quote: All requests to Ecwid REST API require an access token. Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.

evidence.claim: Self-serve credentials: a custom app with tokens is auto-created for any store user
evidence.quote: Ecwid creates one custom app for any user who visits the app dashboard in Ecwid admin for the first time.

evidence.claim: Tokens and app keys (Client ID/secret) are visible on the app page in admin
evidence.quote: On the app page, you will find your public and secret access tokens as well as the app keys (Client ID and Client secret).

evidence.claim: Broad API surface covering store data, payments, shipping, and storefront settings
evidence.quote: Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage any store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings.

notes: Rate limit of 600 requests/minute per token with 429 + Retry-After on excess. Docs migrated from the GitHub-hosted api-docs.ecwid.com to docs.ecwid.com. Also offers a Storefront JS API and webhooks alongside REST. No official Ecwid MCP server found; MCP hits in results were for other vendors (commercetools, monday.com). Material does not state any paid-plan requirement for API access, but does not explicitly confirm a free tier either.
